page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.medium is a memory-optimized virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.m2 server family. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 4 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 4 vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server type does not include any bundled local storage or integrated graphics processing units. Consequently, all storage requirements must be met using external block storage volumes, and workloads requiring hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel GPU computing are not supported. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the instance receives consistent processing performance without resource sharing or CPU credit limitations.

The ecs.m2.medium is structured for workloads that demand a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity. It is suited for hosting in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and mid-sized database management systems where memory capacity is a primary constraint.
